## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — internal change, no user-visible behavior change
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `chore` — tooling, CI, deps
- [ ] `perf` — performance improvement
- [ ] `breaking change` — incompatible API change (mark in commit footer)
